audit_limitations: Saved neural forecasts, optimizer/gradient truth and physical timings are authenticated but not rerun.
Teacher values, original native trajectories and public-filter numerical truth remain inherited evidence.
Independent checks reconstruct full query inputs, selected targets/IPW, saved metrics, 39 condition records and three gates and process/file joins.
Forced-path teacher imitation does not establish autonomous utility, biological learning or architectural novelty.
Initial recurrent equality uses saved hashes, without regenerating initial model tensors.
cost_limitation: No per-fit VALID timing exists. Forward chunks are counts; whole VALID seconds include metrics and I/O.

interactions.scope: descriptive paired-seed factorial contrast; no isolated gradient-conflict claim

scope: Forced-path forecasts only, with separately gated mechanisms and architecture. No omnibus all-39 gate, autonomous performance, new-shift evidence or true action regret.
